summary.zh: 设计并评审 PostgreSQL 表结构与索引
summary.en: Design and review PostgreSQL schemas and indexes

description.zh: 从数据类型、约束、索引到分区等特性，给出 PostgreSQL 表结构的设计与评审要点。适合新建库表、调整既有表结构或排查慢查询时参考。需具备基本的 PostgreSQL 使用经验。
description.en: Reviews and shapes PostgreSQL tables through data types, constraints, indexes and advanced features. Suits creating schemas, revising existing tables or diagnosing slow queries. Assumes basic PostgreSQL experience.
